column3:
up to 99 per slot. A storage box comes with you from the start; other sizes are sold by Dr. Jackson. Items stored in the box only keep their real tags; put labels back on manually after taking them out.

2. Store: drop onto the box and items merge into matching slots or fill empty ones; drop onto a slot in the detail panel to store straight into it.

3. Take: left-click takes 1
column4: right-click takes 5; hold Alt while clicking to put the item straight onto the counter.\n\n4. Durability
column5:
charge and use-count items: values pool into one total per slot. Withdrawal tops slots up in order; once the pool runs dry the rest carry zero value.

5. Liquids: containers of the same size share one slot; empty bottles and their contents are kept together and split by capacity on withdrawal. Items holding liquid can only be placed by dragging them onto a slot; bulk storing will not pick them up.

6. Chemicals: stored separately by grade.

7. Storage expansion kits add pages to a storage box; one box holds at most 5 pages.

8. Items tagged [Storage] [Machine] [Loot] [Module] [Node] [Toolbox] are refused; containers must be emptied first; locked supply crates must be unlocked before storing; homemade wine and question-mark items are refused; animals are refused too (see Main Menu Mod Settings).

column2:
11. Pull Storage / Machine / Smuggler Bay: those areas are included when storing; machines themselves stay put. All three apply to every box in every save and carry across saves.

12. Hide Names: show or hide the names on every box; one setting shared by all saves.

13. Pair Container: click it then click a container; that whole type becomes a stow source including copies bought later.

14. Exclude Container: click it then click one unit of a paired type; that unit is skipped while the rest are still stowed.

15. Reject Item: click it then click an item; this type is never auto-stored again (Store One / Store All / paired containers all skip it). Dropping it on the box body does not store it either; click a specific slot to store it manually.

16. The paired and rejected lists are global and carry across saves and new games; the excluded list is per unit and applies only in the save where you set it. Cancel entries one by one or all at once.
